title: Extend with super.method
prompt: Complete `Truck.describe()` to return the superclass's word followed by " with 6 wheels" — building on `super.describe()`, not duplicating the word.

tests.name: super word
tests.code:
Solution.Truck t = new Solution.Truck();
CjTestBase.checkEq(t.describe(), "vehicle with 6 wheels", "extended text");
